purpose: Measure portfolio performance and risk-state evidence without automatically changing exposure.
design_principle: Separate measurement from action. Risk overlays must earn implementation through out-of-sample evidence against the current Human + Quant + AI baseline.

profit_drawdown.definition: decline in portfolio total-return NAV from its year-to-date high-water mark
profit_drawdown.do_not_use: raw yen profit high-water mark when external contributions or withdrawals are not normalized

execution_policy.cash_round_lot: preferred when 100 shares is a reasonable position size and a resting limit order is useful
execution_policy.odd_lot: consider only when the user can act intraday because odd-lot orders are real-time only in the user's workflow
execution_policy.margin: consider selectively only with explicit holding horizon, maximum loss, exit condition, and cash-position relationship; never treat margin as new investment capital

prohibited_until_validated: automatic de-risking from YTD profit level alone
automatic sell orders from regime labels

validation_gate.baseline: current Human + Quant + AI process with existing portfolio risk engine
validation_gate.promotion_rule: No overlay may change recommended exposure unless it shows a material and robust improvement in downside control without unacceptable degradation of long-run geometric return versus both the current baseline and a simpler alternative.
